lead.headline: 0-3; Lloyd's seat is dead and the flex flips to Golden
lead.deck: Lloyd is Green Bay's third back. Downs is the free-agent fix if he clears.
lead.body: MarShawn Lloyd is Green Bay's third running back: four carries and the fewest snaps of the three in Week 3. The hold that kept him is closed wrong. Oronde Gadsden scored 0.0 on three targets, and the 49ers D/ST scored 1. Bloodsports lost 98.8 to 121.5, and the best lineup available scored 116.0, so the week wasn't winnable. Matthew Golden scored 21.0 on the bench in a coin flip that went the other way. This week the projection puts Golden in the flex over Carnell Tate by a point: take it and move on. Josh Downs, 11 targets with Alec Pierce on IR, replaces Lloyd if he clears waivers at 01:00 Wednesday. Never claim him. This week's opponent is Team 13, the Lamar trade partner, so that offer waits until Week 4 is final.
